display.purpose: Hero title in Young Serif 400 with cyan glow.

motion.name: slab-ease
motion.purpose: Slab and card transform transitions (0.6s slab, 0.35s card).

components.name: Slab
components.css: .ds-slab { position: relative; padding: 3rem; color: #fff; background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 20% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), transparent 55%), linear-gradient(160deg, #3b4a5c 0%, #27333f 55%, #1d2731 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14) inset, 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.45) inset, 0 18px 40px rgba(2,16,28,0.5), 0 2px 6px rgba(2,16,28,0.4); transition: box-shadow 0.6s ease; } .ds-slab:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14) inset, 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.45) inset, 0 18px 40px rgba(2,16,28,0.5), 0 0 24px rgba(0,212,255,0.28); } .ds-slab h2 { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-family: 'Young Serif', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; color: #00d4ff; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1.5rem; color: #d4dde6; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(59,74,92,0.75), rgba(29,39,49,0.85)); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14) inset, 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.45) inset, 0 8px 20px rgba(2,16,28,0.35); transition: transform 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease, border-color 0.35s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(0,212,255,0.35); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14) inset, 0 18px 40px rgba(2,16,28,0.5), 0 0 24px rgba(0,212,255,0.28); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 0.75rem 2rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(to right, #0284c7, #0ea5e9); border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14) inset, 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.45) inset, 0 8px 20px rgba(2,16,28,0.35); transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(2,16,28,0.35), 0 0 24px rgba(0,212,255,0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d4ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { padding: 0.75rem 2rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #00d4ff; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #00d4ff; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #00d4ff; color: #0c4a6e; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(0,212,255,0.28); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d4ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tech Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #e0f2fe; background: rgba(0,212,255,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.25); border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Navigation Panel
components.description: Right-side panel with diamond rune pips.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.1rem 0.9rem; background: rgba(4,32,46,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3); border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.25); border-radius: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14) inset, 0 18px 40px rgba(2,16,28,0.5); } .ds-pip { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; border-radius: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #44546a, #27333f); transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-pip-active { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #b8f4ff, #00d4ff); border-color: #b8f4ff; }

narrative.overview: A poneglyph rests on the ocean floor: heavy carved stone, lit from above by dim water, with cyan glyphs that glow as if they emit light. The voice is calm. Nothing shouts; surfaces are weighty, edges are lit softly, and the only saturated color is the cyan of the glyphs. Depth comes from light and layered elevation, never from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Ocean/abyss blue field, stone-grey slabs, cyber-cyan accent used for glyphs, glow, active state and headings.
Soft layered elevation: lit top edge, dark bottom edge, deep diffuse drop shadow, cyan glow on hover.
Carved-stone slabs and cards with an inset inner border.
3D is CSS-only and flattens on small screens and under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Light Source Rule
rules.body: Cyan is emitted light, never a flat fill for large areas. It appears as text, glow, thin borders (12 to 35% alpha) and small active marks.

rules.name: The Solid Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are solid colors with a soft drop-shadow glow. Gradient-clipped text is retired.

rules.name: The Single Weight Rule
rules.body: Display faces stay at weight 400. Emphasis comes from size, color and glow, not bold.

rules.name: The Flat Fallback Rule
rules.body: Under 768px and under prefers-reduced-motion, perspective is removed and all 3D transforms, entrance animation and hover lifts are flattened. Depth is then carried by the shadows alone.

rules.name: The Lit Edge Rule
rules.body: Raised means a light top edge, dark bottom edge and soft deep shadow together; never a single hard offset shadow.

dos: Do keep display type in Young Serif at weight 400 and body in DM Sans.
Do build every raised surface from Elevation 1 or 2 and add the cyan glow only on hover or for glyphs.
Do use cyan as light: headings, glyphs, thin borders and active marks.
Do use CSS 3D only, and flatten it under 768px and under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep text at WCAG AA contrast over ocean and stone.
donts: Don't use a gradient fill on heading text.
Don't use JavaScript or canvas for depth; 3D stays in CSS transforms.
Don't replace the poneglyph materials (ocean field, stone blocks, cyan glyphs) with another world.
Don't add bold to Young Serif headings.
Don't touch the scroll teleport and overlay behavior when restyling.
